Updating the balance to match the report can conceal missing postings; a correction procedure should create an adjustment entry with an identity and reason.
Jangan menahan transaction database keti: Do not hold a database transaction while waiting on the network. A local exactly-once effect means local uniqueness plus a transaction contract; it does not mean provider money moves once without provider support or reconciliation.
Jaringan, queue, dan webhook umumnya mem: Networks, queues, and webhooks generally provide at-least-once delivery: a message can repeat, arrive late, or lose its response after the server commits. The provable target is one local effect for one stable business identity within a defined scope. For example, one payment_intent or merchant_id/provider_ref pair produces at most one effect row and one ledger posting. The delivery count may be two or more; the constrained effect is what must be one.

Transaction lokal dan external call berb: The local transaction and external call have different boundaries
Transaction lokal dapat memasukkan payme: A local transaction can include the payment effect, ledger entries, and outbox event atomically. After commit, a worker reads the outbox and calls the provider with a provider-side idempotency key when available. The worker can send twice if it crashes after the provider accepts the request but before the worker marks success. A provider that understands the key can return the same result; a provider without such a key needs explicit reconciliation and compensation.
Tujuan tepatnya adalah effect lokal seka: The precise goal is one local effect

Scope merchant_id memungkinkan key pay-2: The merchant_id scope allows key pay-2026-001 to appear for two merchants without a collision. The shop-a retry with h-a1 is classified as replayed_same_payload; the h-a2 callback is classified as payload_conflict by the report and does not change the successful payment or effect_count. Shop-b has no incoming callback and remains unchanged. signature_valid only lets the fixture message enter the path; it is not a replacement for UNIQUE, and this example sends no external provider effect.
Reference memakai UNIQUE (merchant_id, i: The reference uses UNIQUE (merchant_id, idempotency_key) as the arbiter and accepts only incoming rows with signature_valid. The report separates retry h-a1 as replayed_same_payload and callback h-a2 as payload_conflict; the successful payment row remains succeeded and effect_count remains one. Shop-b remains unchanged because it has no incoming callback. A different payload must not be updated silently. This script does not prove signature cryptography, network exactly-once, or a provider side effect.
Dataset A memiliki merchant shop-a dan s: Dataset A has merchants shop-a and shop-b that may use the same idempotency_key text because their scopes differ. The shop-a row already has a successful payment. The incoming table has a shop-a retry with the same payload_hash and one shop-a callback with a different payload_hash. The script processes them through two separate INSERT statements so one ON CONFLICT does not affect the same arbiter row more than once. The final report separates identical replay, payload conflict, and a merchant without a callback without changing the successful payment fact.
